lines.en:
Over here, prisoner.  Letter for you.
From a friend of yours.  And I've been told to bring you whatever you need to finish the task in the letter.  You are one lucky bastard...

Protagonist...
"Tahnra owes you greatly, Lysander, for sparing it the rule of another tyrant... the one I could have become.   I have one last request of you."
"Give our country the blueprints to a better world..."  Very well, Protagonist. It will be done.
lines.name: 莱桑德
